versions.changelog:
- Major cleanup: removed all CLI helper and script files—skill now serves only as a command/documentation layer.
- SKILL.md overhauled: rewritten to clarify that all trades use real ETH/WETH on Arbitrum One, with strong warnings about fund safety.
- Updated all CLI examples to pin to @clawlogic/sdk@0.2.0 and improved instructions for setup, upgrading, and agent eligibility.
- Command triggers in the description now emphasize explicit "CLAWLOGIC" context.
- Added guidance: always get explicit user confirmation before sending transactions, unless delegated trading is approved.
- Documentation is more concise and focused on safety and correct usage; all details and FAQs remain in SKILL.md.

clawlogic version 1.0.0

- Major rewrite of skill documentation in SKILL.md: now clearer on triggers, agent flow, and all command use-cases.
- Skill description expanded: covers market discovery, trading, liquidity, market creation, outcome assertion & dispute, and posting rationales.
- Setup instructions updated for Arbitrum One mainnet; details added about wallet setup, funding, and registration requirements.
- Commands for market finding, quoting, trading, and liquidity provision are now clearly separated and described.
- Instructions on market creation improved: enforce no duplicates, require specific question standards, and advise on resolution details.
- Old, redundant file (skill-card.md) removed.

clawlogic-trader initial release.

- Enables full participation in CLAWLOGIC prediction markets: wallet setup, agent registration, market creation, analysis, trading, assertion, settlement, fee claiming, and broadcast posting.
- Provides npm/npx-based agent CLI for all market actions with no extra config required.
- Structured JSON responses for all commands, suitable for automation.
- Includes optional ENS registration and linking.
- Detailed stepwise instructions and sample commands for every supported market interaction.
